question: Primary human dermal fibroblasts stop expanding around passage 8 on our new scaffold but not on plastic. Why?
goal: Decide what to measure first, given almost nothing has been measured yet.
constraints: no senescence panel has been run
budget for one experiment before the next review

evidence.statement: Expansion slows sharply around passage 8 on scaffold; plastic controls continue
evidence.measurement_context: cell counts, n=1 scaffold lot, no replicates, not blinded
